news.title: Oil Traders in Talks With QatarEnergy for Long-Term Supplies
news.summary: Some of the world’s top commodity-trading houses are in talks to secure more long-term supplies of Qatari crude, seeking to build on their success at shuttling oil out of the Persian Gulf during the Iran-US war.

news.title: Lynch Yacht Crew Unaware of Wind Risk Before Fatal Sinking, UK Report Finds
news.summary: The crew of British tech tycoon Mike Lynch's yacht, which sank off Sicily in 2024 killing him and six others, was unaware of its vulnerability to strong winds because the risk had never been assessed, a British investigation found on Thursday.

news.title: U.S. Targets Ship-to-Ship Transfers in Expanded Iran Maritime Blockade
news.summary: The US military will treat ships that receive cargo at sea from vessels loaded in Iran as attempting to evade its blockade of Iranian ports and could take action against them, according to an advisory issued by US Central Command (CENTCOM) on Wednesday.
